{"consolidated_memory":"Plan drift issues in infra/terraform/vpc.tf VPC module

Multiple separate incidents, all in the same file, all triggered by "run plan twice with no changes in between":

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-22]
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: diff on a resource nobody edited
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #3735 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Result: flaky test went from 27 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2: [2026-03-30]
- Trigger: first request after a cold start
- Signal: diff on a resource nobody edited
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #5176 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
- Result: 82 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 3: [2026-06-28]
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Signal: diff on a resource nobody edited
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #7685 on branch fix/plan-drift-3
- Result: cold start dropped 5 percent, to 50 ms

All work was on the infrastructure side in the same corner of the file, with context carrying over from earlier plan drift work."}
